subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the shipped Nostr import endpoint retain explicit `autoMerge: true` while the Control UI switches to cancellable draft imports?
rationale: The UI race can be fixed without deleting the documented HTTP behavior, so removing that behavior requires explicit owner intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Preserve explicit auto-merge
options.body: Keep the server option for existing callers while the Control UI sends draft mode and uses cancellation plus stale-response invalidation.

options.title: Retire auto-merge
options.body: Approve a breaking draft-only endpoint, update the public contract, and require fresh-install and upgrade proof for callers relying on the old behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit auto-merge
recommendation.body: Keep the server option for existing callers while the Control UI sends draft mode and uses cancellation plus stale-response invalidation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history points to involvement with the shipped Nostr profile mutation boundary and its prior hardening.
